prototype.headline: Instant self-serve OAuth app registration; private integrations work immediately without provider review.

production.waitTime: none for private; 1-2 weeks for Public Directory listing
production.headline: Workspace-internal applications require no approval. Only apps published to the public Linear integration directory require review.

verdict.confidence: high on self-serve developer access, scopes, and token mechanics
verdict.summary: Linear provides a developer-friendly OAuth 2.0 system. Anyone with workspace admin privileges can create an OAuth application, configure redirect URIs, and immediately connect. Review is only required if listing on the public Linear integration directory.

steps.text: Sign in to your Linear organization with an account that has Admin permissions.

stages.name: Create OAuth Application in Linear Developer Settings

steps.text: Navigate to Linear Settings > Workspace > API > Applications (https://linear.app/settings/api/applications).
Click 'Create new application', input an application name, and add the Composio redirect URI.
Select required scopes ('read', 'write', or 'issues:create') and save the app.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into your password manager or secure vault.
In Composio Dashboard navigate to Auth Configs > Create Auth Config > Linear.
Enter the Client ID and Client Secret obtained from Linear, then save.
The agent generates the authorization URL with session.authorize('linear') and verifies that the connected account status transitions to ACTIVE.

requirements: Linear account with Workspace Admin permissions
Secure storage for Linear Client Secret

agentCanDo: Generate Composio authorization links with session.authorize('linear')

Run test issue queries and report status
youMustDo: Sign in to Linear workspace and create the OAuth app
Copy Client ID and Client Secret to Composio
Authorize the application in the Linear browser consent screen

claims.text: Linear uses OAuth 2.0 with Authorization endpoint https://linear.app/oauth/authorize and Token endpoint https://api.linear.app/oauth/token.
Private OAuth applications created for internal workspace use do not require review or approval by Linear.
Only workspace members with Admin roles can manage and create OAuth applications in Linear.
Linear access tokens have a 30-day lifespan and refresh tokens remain valid indefinitely until revoked.
Linear is a managed toolkit in Composio with support for both managed auth and custom OAuth credentials.
GET request to https://linear.app/authorize with client_id=INVALID returned HTTP 200 indicating the endpoint is responsive.

nextAction: Open https://linear.app/settings/api/applications to create your Linear OAuth app.
composioTail: In the Composio dashboard go to Auth Configs, click Create Auth Config, select the toolkit and choose OAuth2.
Copy the redirect URI shown in the Composio dashboard and register it in the provider's app settings.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the provider app overview into the Composio auth config, and click Create.
Copy the resulting auth config ID (looks like ac_xxxx). Keep secrets out of source control.
Pass the auth config ID to your session: authConfigs: { [toolkit]: 'ac_xxxx' }. Toolkits not listed keep using Composio managed auth.
